capabilities: Log sets, reps, weights and durations through a low-touch workout editor that autosaves
Run interval sessions such as Tabata or EMOM on a full-screen timer that writes reps to the note
Generate a fitness dashboard with recent sessions and personal bests per exercise
Show per-exercise progression charts and recent-session tables on exercise notes
Rename, consolidate and repair exercises from a settings registry
extras: Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Documented limitations include manual conflict resolution, dropped unrecognised inline fields on save, and interval beeps that cannot sound while the phone suspends Obsidian.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to log workouts during training or run timed interval sessions like Tabata or EMOM.

relations.evidence: FitKit needs the Dataview plugin to render history tables and recent-session views.

summary: Workout tracker that logs sets, reps, weights and interval sessions as Markdown notes with inline fields, plus a dashboard and per-exercise charts.
